subject: Your prediction before Predictify — 3 days ago
preview_text: The difference is embarrassing. One tap shows how far you've come.
body_paragraphs: Three days ago, you made a call on a match without checking a single stat. Maybe it was a gut feeling on a Derby County upset or a hunch that Inter would blow past Fiorentina. How did that turn out?

Now open the app and look at your prediction history. Compare that guess to what the AI would have shown you: 87% confidence on Inter, backed by xG, defensive leaks, and head-to-head data. The before version of you was guessing. The after version has receipts.

This is what happens when you let data do the heavy lifting. Every match you check now — from Premier League to the Champions League — you see confidence scores, player stats, and tactical breakdowns that make the old way feel like throwing darts blindfolded. The IQ Quiz even lets you test how much you've leveled up.

Open Predictify and check your last 5 predictions. See the gap. Then make your next one with the AI's help. P.S. The 3-day trial for Premium is still active — unlimited predictions and advanced stats are waiting.
